channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: 60-Year-Old Gujarat Man Loses Rs 2.52 Crore in YouTube-Linked WhatsApp Stock Trading Scam Trap
item.description: A Valsad retiree poured Rs 2.52 crore into a fake trading app after WhatsApp lures promised Rs 33 crore profits, only to face impossible withdrawal fees.

item.title: Restore 50/100: NITI Aayog’s Bold Push for Viksit Bharat at WRI’s RESTORE 2025
item.description: NITI Aayog’s Restore 50/100 blueprint aims to convert degraded land into economic, climate, and community wealth for a sustainable Viksit Bharat 2047.

item.title: ‘No Antibiotics, No Compromise’: Eggoz Founder Hits Back at Viral ‘Cancer-Causing Eggs’ Allegation
item.description: A viral YouTube test alleging banned AOZ in Eggoz eggs has sparked cancer fears, denials, and demands for clearer food safety checks.

item.title: Zubeen Garg Death Case: Assam SIT Files Murder Charges Against Four, Cousin Faces Culpable Homicide
item.description: The Assam SIT filed a 12,000-page chargesheet, charging four with murder and the singer's cousin with culpable homicide.

item.title: Amid IndiGo Chaos, Govt ‘Stepped In Immediately’ to Cap Airfares, Says Aviation Minister; Prices on Par with Global Norms
item.description: Aviation Minister Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu imposes fare caps up to ₹18,000 as IndiGo's pilot shortage triggers over 1,000 cancellations and ₹500 crore in passenger payouts.

item.title: IAS Supriya Sahu’s 2025 UNEP Award: Leadership That Created 2.5 Million Green Jobs and Boosted Forest Cover
item.description: Tamil Nadu IAS officer Supriya Sahu earns UNEP's 2025 Champions of the Earth award for pioneering ecosystem restoration, green jobs, and climate resilience in the Nilgiris.

item.title: NHAI Introduces India’s First Red Table-Top Marking for Wildlife Safety on Bhopal–Jabalpur Highway
item.description: India gets its first 5 mm "table-top red marking" to save wildlife on the Bhopal–Jabalpur Highway.

item.title: Woman Fired for Habitually Arriving 40 Minutes Early at Work in Spain, Court Rules in Employer’s Favor
item.description: A Spanish employee fired for consistently arriving 40 minutes early lost her court challenge against her boss.

item.title: Pakistan University Introduces Sanskrit Course, Adds Mahabharata and Gita to Curriculum
item.description: Lahore University of Management Sciences marks a cultural milestone by wrapping up its groundbreaking Sanskrit course, covering epics like Mahabharata and Gita to foster homegrown expertise since 1947.

item.title: Valsad Horror: Five Workers Injured as Girder Slips from Over-Raised Jack on Rs 42 Crore Auranga River Bridge
item.description: A girder collapse due to a faulty jack adjustment injured five workers on Valsad's Rs 42 crore Auranga River bridge, prompting an inquiry and ex-gratia payouts amid insurance assurances.
